# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 5 tokens; Text — 9 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 5 tokens; Borders and rings — 6 tokens; Charts — 8 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 63 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 10 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Size — 11 tokens; Font size — 13 tokens; Font weight — 4 tokens; Line height — 5 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--z-color-background-default, #0d1f1a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #0d1f1a;
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | oscuro | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--z-color-background-default` | #0d1f1a | Fondo principal de la app |
| `--z-color-background-surface` | #162b25 | Superficie de cards, inputs y nav |
| `--z-color-background-surfaceAlt` | #1a312a | Superficie alternativa / hover de card |
| `--z-color-background-elevated` | #1f3b32 | Superficie elevada (modal, tooltip, dropdown) |
| `--z-color-background-overlay` | #00000080 | Overlay para modales y drawers |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 32px/1.1 "Satoshi", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl);
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

## Spacing

Escala de 4 a 64.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--z-space-4);
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | value | usage |

| `--z-space-4` | 4px | Separación ícono–texto; padding vertical de insignias. |
| `--z-space-8` | 8px | Separación mínima entre objetivos táctiles; dentro de controles. |
| `--z-space-12` | 12px | Entre filas relacionadas dentro de una card. |
| `--z-space-16` | 16px | Padding de card (z-size-card-padding), padding horizontal de botón y campo, medianil. |
| `--z-space-20` | 20px | Margen lateral de pantalla (z-size-grid-margin). |
| `--z-space-24` | 24px | Entre secciones dentro de una pantalla. |
| `--z-space-32` | 32px | Entre bloques grandes. |
| `--z-space-40` | 40px | Separación amplia. |
| `--z-space-48` | 48px | Separación amplia; igual al alto de botón. |
| `--z-space-64` | 64px | Separación máxima; igual al alto de la barra inferior. |

| `--z-font-weight-bold` | 700 | Display (Satoshi) y Data (JetBrains Mono). |

## Line height

Primitivas de referencia; los estilos compuestos llevan el interlineado ratificado.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--z-font-lineHeight-tight: 1.1) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--z-font-lineHeight-tight), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--z-font-lineHeight-tight` | 1.1 | Display – títulos grandes · Referencia (Display XL). Los estilos compuestos llevan el interlineado ratificado en uso. |
| `--z-font-lineHeight-snug` | 1.15 | Display L y M · Referencia (Display L). Ídem. |
| `--z-font-lineHeight-normal` | 1.2 | UI / Data · Referencia (UI/Data). Ídem. |
| `--z-font-lineHeight-relaxed` | 1.4 | Body/S y Body/XS · Referencia (Body S/XS). Ídem. |
| `--z-font-lineHeight-loose` | 1.45 | Body/M – lectura cómoda · Referencia (Body M). Ídem. |
